title: Transcription factors ERalpha and Sox2 have differing multiphasic DNA and RNA binding mechanisms.
authors: Hemphill, Wayne O; Steiner, Halley R; Kominsky, Jackson R; Wuttke, Deborah S; Cech, Thomas R
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物物理实验研究ERalpha和Sox2转录因子与DNA/RNA的多相结合动力学，虽无AI或MD方法，但聚焦TF-核酸互作机制建模，对TF-DNA动态结合机理有参考价值。
abstract: Many transcription factors (TFs) have been shown to bind RNA, leading to open questions regarding the mechanism(s) of this RNA binding and its role in regulating TF activities. Here we use biophysical assays to interrogate the kon, koff, and Kd for DNA and RNA binding of two model human transcription factors, ERalpha and Sox2. Unexpectedly, we found that both proteins exhibited multiphasic nucleic acid binding kinetics. We propose that Sox2 RNA and DNA multiphasic binding kinetics could be explained by a conventional model for sequential Sox2 monomer association and dissociation. In contrast, ERalpha nucleic acid binding exhibited biphasic dissociation paired with novel triphasic association behavior, where two apparent binding transitions are separated by a 10-20 min "lag" phase depending on protein concentration. We considered several conventional models for the observed kinetic behavior, none of which adequately explained all the ERalpha nucleic acid binding data. Instead, simulations with a model incorporating sequential ERalpha monomer association, ERalpha nucleic acid complex isomerization, and product "feedback" on isomerization rate recapitulated the general kinetic trends for both ERalpha DNA and RNA binding. Collectively, our findings reveal that Sox2 and ERalpha bind RNA and DNA with previously unappreciated multiphasic binding kinetics, and that their reaction mechanisms differ with ERalpha binding nucleic acids via a novel reaction mechanism.
abstract_zh: 许多转录因子（TFs）已被证明能结合RNA，这引发了关于这种RNA结合机制及其在调控TF活性中作用的开放性问题。在此，我们使用生物物理测定法来探究两种模型人类转录因子ERalpha和Sox2与DNA和RNA结合的kon、koff及Kd。出乎意料的是，我们发现这两种蛋白质均表现出多相核酸结合动力学。我们提出，Sox2的RNA和DNA多相结合动力学可通过Sox2单体顺序结合和解离的常规模型来解释。相比之下，ERalpha的核酸结合表现出双相解离，并伴有新颖的三相结合行为，其中两个明显的结合转变被一个10-20分钟的“滞后”阶段分隔，该阶段取决于蛋白质浓度。我们考虑了多种常规模型来解释观察到的动力学行为，但没有一个能充分解释所有ERalpha核酸结合数据。相反，采用包含ERalpha单体顺序结合、ERalpha核酸复合物异构化以及产物对异构化速率的“反馈”作用的模型进行模拟，重现了ERalpha DNA和RNA结合的一般动力学趋势。总体而言，我们的发现揭示Sox2和ERalpha以先前未被认识的多相结合动力学结合RNA和DNA，且它们的反应机制不同，ERalpha通过一种新颖的反应机制结合核酸。
